scope: Source/UI only. No actual result/model loaded by author, and no scientific imports, searches, training, native queries or replays.
entry: viewer.js autostarts once DOM is ready and #reader exists. Fetches visual-data.json unless #reader.dataset.visualUrl supplies a URL. To mount supplied data manually, set window.GCTS_GEOMETRY_READER_NO_AUTOSTART=true before script load, then call GCTSGeometryReader.mount(data).
math_renderer: Root supplies established MathJax with typesetPromise; waits for startup.promise and clears earlier typeset state. Only displayed hypotheses/target/selected certificate formulas are converted or typeset, never the complete formula registry. Every mathematical expression uses LaTeX.

ast.unknown_tag: Throws explicitly; terms are not accepted as formulas. Function and predicate arguments use the frozen third-field array convention.

data.formula_codes: Exact zero-indexed formula AST registry. Only needed entries are read.
data.recipes: Original ordered recipe array; each recipe has id, primitive_witness and ordered_premise_formulas.
data.scope: Optional root-authored human text rendered using textContent.
data.observations: Original source observations plus root id and independent flags; no inference of success from mode, metrics, decoded word or training status.

observation.attempts: Saved actual attempts; missing means explicitly not supplied
observation.seconds: Original numeric/object time field displayed verbatim
observation.node_count: Original saved node count displayed verbatim
observation.limits: Original source limit object displayed verbatim
observation.point_certificate: null or original decorated placement certificate
observation.decoded_certificate: null or original decoded certificate; local_certificate.proof commands are separately inspectable without guessing their expansion correspondence
observation.independent_certificate_accepted: boolean; only literal true displays root independent certificate acceptance, default pending
observation.independent_trace_accepted: boolean; only literal true displays root independent trace acceptance, default pending
observation.independent_scope: Optional root human text displayed verbatim

identity_preimage.prototype_preimage: Original prototype: recipe_id, primitive_witness, ordered_premise_formulas, relative_ordered_input_offsets, orientation identity, relative t/m supports
identity_preimage.t: Absolute t supports, byte-value correspondence checked for display
identity_preimage.m: Absolute m supports, byte-value correspondence checked for display

display_checks: Sort placements by exact saved row; reject duplicate/negative rows.
Top command/t/m equal identity_preimage counterparts; absolute supports equal shifted prototype supports.
Output mark at (1,row) references formula_codes[code] equal command.formula.
Each ordered source strictly precedes row and its prior output equals ordered premise.
Relative offsets equal source-row; purple source mark at (2+input,source) carries that premise code.
These UI integrity checks are not independent mathematical/native proof checking.
visual: One fixed-orientation physical square per saved placement, sorted by row, with blue output and purple ordered negative-reference layer toggles. Full formula and faithful rule/source-ref English appear beside it. All actual t/m/key/id data remain inspectable.
missing_certificate: Display original status, metrics, hypotheses/target and selected saved initial/event/terminal state projection. Show full keys/totals/marks/refcounts/selected generations/roots/exclusions/domains, hint state and complete event. Never synthesize proof rows from a trace.
safety: Native DOM creation and textContent only; no innerHTML, eval, scientific engine, checker or policy import. Fetch is data loading for root-integrated browser only. No dependencies beyond root-established MathJax.
actual_data_qa: Pending root integration of actual terminal data and browser QA; no author claim actual tile layout, formula rendering, certificate acceptance or trace validity has passed.
